description: Decode Base64 back to text. Accepts the standard and the URL-safe alphabet (even mixed), missing '=' padding, spaces and line breaks, and data URIs such as data:image/png;base64,... Returns the decoded UTF-8 text exactly. If the bytes are not valid UTF-8 (an image, compressed or encrypted data), says so and returns them as hex instead. Invalid input fails with the reason and the position of the offending character.

data.description: Base64 text or a data: URI.

name: base64_decode
title: Base64 decode
